verdicts.summary: [L] proves less than [M] prints. [M] prints `The stationary Gaussian integral, including the inherited loop action and Haar density, has field-dependent factor $\mathrm e^{-\mathsf T(v)}$`.
evidence: [M] says the stationary Gaussian integral has field-dependent factor e^{−𝖳(v)} and that 𝖰(v) is positive near zero (B-section.tex:385-392). In [L], `treasury` (Joint/HaarJac.lean:63), `toll_pos` (Work/F05/Measure.lean:37), `carries` (Joint/Regulator.lean:527) and `commandment` (Joint/Completion.lean:384) give J_ax = |det Ds| > 0, X𝓡 = I and det(𝓡,𝓘)² = 1. But 𝖰 is positive definite only at v = 0 (`tested_diag`, Graphs.lean:29; `bend_det_pos`, Calculus.lean:79), near zero [L] has only det 𝖰(v) > 0 (`hessian_pos`, Graphs.lean:75), and `tribute` (HaarJac.lean:177) only unfolds 𝖳, so no declaration evaluates the integral to e^{−𝖳}.

`tested_diag` (Work/F05/Graphs.lean:29-35) gives positivity of the form at x = 0. `hessian_pos` (:75-79), via `bend_det_pos` (Calculus.lean:73-75), gives only det > 0 near 0, and PosDef appears only at 0 (Calculus.lean:79). `thermal_eq` (Push/LOOP_COEFFICIENT/Shell.lean:201-204) identifies T with loop + scalar but evaluates no stationary Gaussian integral to e^{−T(v)}.
